name: capacity-plan
program:
# Depot capacity model.                                                    #
# Routes are simulated rather than listed, so the only way to learn        #
# anything about the distribution is to compute it.                        #

let noise : Int -> Int =
  fun i -> int_mod(i * 7919 + 104729, 10007)
in
let fleet_size = 400 in

# A route is (id, region, distance_km, load_units). #
let routes : [(Int, Int, Int, Int)] =
  init(fleet_size, fun i ->
    (i,
     int_mod(noise(i), 5),
     int_mod(noise(i + 1), 120) + 10,
     int_mod(noise(i + 2), 40) + 1))
in

let route_id : (Int, Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (r, _, _, _) -> r
in
let region : (Int, Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, g, _, _) -> g
in
let distance : (Int, Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, _, d, _) -> d
in
let load : (Int, Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, _, _, l) -> l
in

let km_rate = 3 in
let handling_rate = 7 in

# Handling is charged once per route here. #
let cost_of : (Int, Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun r -> distance(r) * km_rate + handling_rate
in

let sum : [Int] -> Int =
  fun xs -> fold_left(xs, fun (acc, n) -> acc + n, 0)
in
let count : [(Int, Int, Int, Int)] -> Int =
  fun rs -> length(rs)
in

let in_region : Int -> [(Int, Int, Int, Int)] =
  fun g -> filter(routes, fun r -> region(r) == g)
in
let costs_of : [(Int, Int, Int, Int)] -> [Int] =
  fun rs -> map(rs, cost_of)
in

let total_cost = sum(costs_of(routes)) in

total_cost

steps.label: update_definition
actions: (Structural(Update Definition cost_of"fun r -> distance(r) * km_rate + load(r) * handling_rate"))

steps.label: insert_after
actions:
(Structural(Insert After total_cost"let heavy_cutoff : Int = 20 in
let heavy : [(Int, Int, Int, Int)] =
  let filter_heavy(rs) =
    case rs
    | [] => []
    | hd :: tl =>
        if load(hd) > heavy_cutoff
          then hd :: filter_heavy(tl)
          else filter_heavy(tl)
    end
  in
  filter_heavy(routes)
in
let heavy_count = count(heavy) in"))

steps.label: insert_after
actions:
(Structural(Insert After heavy_count"let region_cost(r_id) = sum(costs_of(in_region(r_id))) in
let costs = (region_cost(0), region_cost(1), region_cost(2), region_cost(3), region_cost(4)) in
let cheapest_region =
  let (c0, c1, c2, c3, c4) = costs in
  if c0 <= c1 && c0 <= c2 && c0 <= c3 && c0 <= c4 then 0
  else if c1 <= c2 && c1 <= c3 && c1 <= c4 then 1
  else if c2 <= c3 && c2 <= c4 then 2
  else if c3 <= c4 then 3
  else 4
in"))
